rows.note: Use this for the greatest spatial or temporal distance, such as running or reaching the furthest.

example.english: We ran to the furthest signpost before stopping.
example.traditional: 我哋跑到最遠嗰個路牌先停低。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 paau2 dou3 zeoi3 jyun5 go2 go3 lou6 paai4 sin1 ting4 dai1

rows.note: Use this before a gradable verb or adjective when “furthest” means to the greatest degree, as in 發展得最先進.

example.english: Of the proposals, this one is the furthest developed.
example.traditional: 幾個方案入面，呢個發展得最先進。
example.jyutping: gei2 go3 fong1 on3 jap6 min6 ni1 go3 faat3 zin2 dak1 zeoi3 sin1 zeon3
